change_summary: The alert records a retraction of the paper with no notice attached, and the current copy of the paper is marked as retracted in its title. The stored paper's title carries no retraction marking, and apart from that marking no difference in the text was found between the stored paper and the current copy. The retraction applies to the whole paper, including the headline finding that winter cover crops raised topsoil carbon by 6% over three years and the reusable sampling protocol. The retraction is confirmed by the current copy, but no retraction notice was available, so its reason is unknown.
evaluation: In Methods section 2.2, your draft cites [5] as the protocol it follows exactly for sampling 0-15 cm soil cores and measuring carbon by dry combustion, and apart from one added step for cracked cores, it says no step of the protocol has been changed. The tracked paper measured soil carbon by dry combustion on 0-15 cm cores using its own sampling protocol, and the alert records a retraction of the paper with no notice attached, while the current copy is marked as retracted in its title. The retraction covers the paper whose protocol your Methods follow, so this use is touched. The impact on your draft is high, because it relies on the retracted paper for its core method.
